invariants: Importing the React package or bridge does not require window, document, HTMLElement, or customElements at module evaluation time.
Custom-element registration runs only from client lifecycle effects and is idempotent when the tag is already registered.
Server rendering does not execute registration, property assignment, or canonical event subscription side effects.
Hydration preserves server markup and applies canonical properties/events after the element ref is attached.
Registration helpers tolerate environments without a CustomElementRegistry and do not duplicate definitions.
